Name: Shardust's Wallpapers and Floors for Alternative Textures
Author: Shardust
Description:
After a 'brief' interlude with the greyscale (my hair mods) I have returned to the wonderful world of colors.

Allow me to present additional custom walls and floors for Alternative Textures.
They will be available from AT's interface and Pierre's Catalogue, and will not overwrite the vanilla textures, so you can have them all.
There are 12 walls with 24 colors each (total 288), and 6 floors with 24 colors each (total 144).
(There will be updates with more patterns in the following months)

[i]I know that 12/6 seems such a low number, but each one has, again, -24- colors options, because I wanted them to match my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3751]Dynamic interior mod[/url].
I do plan on more patterns, but it will take a while.
(I might also do a recolor of some of the vanilla walls/floors eventually, at a later time)[/i]

Wallpapers and floors will be available in two ways:
1) In Pierre's Catalogue item when you purchase it, following the vanilla textures (just keep scrolling down).
2) By purchasing the Paint Bucket tool from Robin (AT required) which
allows you to search them by name in the Alternative Textures' UI.

In the Alternative Texture UI, each wallpaper and floor type is labeled and searchable with those terms:
Material:
brick, wood, tiled
Type:
rough, smooth, wall, trim (when clicking the wall)
rough, smooth, floor (when clicking the floor)
Color:
walnut, umber, ash, coal, mocha, cream, cocoa, oak,
amber, aquamarine, topaz, emerald, amethyst, spinel, ruby, sapphire,
steel, ice, honey, olive, saffron, rust, wine, blackberry,
(For anything else about how to use Alternative Textures, look up their mod page)

Thanks for checking out my mods!
